The harbor_timesheet_policy_audit task achieved a perfect verifier score by successfully passing the legacy pytest suite.
The execution resulted in a 1.000 mean reward across 1 trial with zero exceptions. The verifier confirmed success via test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite using pytest version 8.4.1. While the 3m 36s runtime indicates a stable environment, future iterations should ensure the audit logic remains robust against variations in timesheet data formats.
